metadataRaw.title: How to Fix a Neck Hump With an Athletic Cup
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to fix a neck hump for good AT HOME!

A neck hump (aka buffalo hump or a Dowager's hump) is an unsightly issue that may be caused by poor neck and upper back POSTURE. 

Over time, this poor posture may cause muscles to WEAKEN and start to form an excessive curvature around the upper back (kyphosis) and the neck. We're going to tackle this issue with an easy-to-follow two part process.

FIRST, we'll focus on getting everything moving with easy, effective stretching exercises that will build more mobility in the upper back and neck. This will include the athletic cup exercise that works wonders for getting rid of a neck hump.

SECOND, we'll focus on strengthening exercises to help build stronger muscles in the upper back and neck, which may not only fix a neck hump, but help improve posture as well.

WATCH now and fix your neck hump for good!
